home.title: Practice the scam call before it happens.
home.lead: Take a short, fictional scam call. Reply by tapping or by voice. Then see each pressure trick the caller used, and the safer reply.
safety.notice: Everything here is fictional. Never type real names, numbers, codes or PINs. Nothing you do here is stored.
voice.note: Voice uses your browser's speech feature. Some browsers send speech to their provider to convert it to text. Turn voice off to avoid this. Nothing is recorded or stored by Scam Gym.

real.title: If this happened for real
real.1: Call your bank using the number on your card.

family.title: Set a family code word
family.intro: A copied voice can sound exactly like someone you love. A code word is something a scammer cannot copy. Agree on it now, in person or on a normal call, before anyone needs it.
family.label: Your family code word or phrase
family.inputNote: Kept on this screen only. It is never stored or sent anywhere.
family.message: Our family code word is {word}. If anyone calls asking for money, ask for it. If they cannot say it, hang up and call me on my normal number.
family.typeFirst: Type a word or phrase first.
family.copied: Copied. Paste it in a private message to each family member.
family.copyFailed: Copy did not work in this browser. Select the text below and copy it.
family.warning: Do not share the word in public groups or on social media. Send it privately, or say it in person.
about.title: About Scam Gym
about.lead: Scam Gym is a fire drill for scam calls. You take a fictional call, reply, and get a debrief that names each pressure trick and the safer reply.
about.how1: Pick a drill and take the call. The caller's words are always shown on screen.
about.how2: Reply by tapping. If you turn voice on, you can also speak your reply.
about.how3: When the call ends, the debrief shows each trick the caller used and the habit to keep.
about.habit: The one habit: stop, do not act on what the caller gave you, and verify through a channel you already trust. Call the number on your card, check your own banking app, or ask the family code word.
about.limitation: Scam Gym builds a habit through simulated practice. It cannot detect or stop real scams, and a real caller with a spoofed number or detailed personal information may be more convincing than any drill.
about.voiceLimitation: Voice recognition accuracy varies by accent, device and browser. Tap mode is always available.
about.privacy1: No accounts, no cookies, no trackers.
about.privacy2: All people, banks and amounts in the drills are invented.
about.privacy3: Your replies stay on your device. The optional study saves only your answers, your language and a random ID.
about.privacy4: Voice is off by default. Your browser's speech feature may send audio to its provider when voice is on.
about.translationNote: Spanish and French text was drafted with AI assistance and has not been reviewed by a native speaker yet.
about.credit1: Browser Web Speech APIs (speech synthesis and speech recognition)
about.credit3: LLM provider: none by default. Optional rephrasing can use a provider set by the host.
about.built: Built during Oct 17 to Nov 22, 2026 with AI coding assistance (Claude Code).

study.title: Before-and-after study
study.consent: This is a short anonymous study for a hackathon project. We record only your answers and a random ID. No names or contact details. You can stop at any time.
study.about: You answer 5 short questions, play any two drills, then answer 5 different questions. It takes about 5 minutes.
study.agreeFirst: Please tick the box to agree first, or go back to the drills.
study.drillsBody: Play any two different drills. After each call, come back here from the debrief.
study.saved: Your answers were saved anonymously. Thank you.
study.notSaved: Your results could not be saved, but you can still keep going.
study.safeAnswerNote: A safe answer is one where you stop and verify through a channel you already trust.
study.habit: Stop. Do not act on what the caller gave you. Verify through a channel you already trust.
